plan.title: Invited vendor sees event in Live list

steps.note: Create the live event required by the setup.
Provide a known title so the vendor event can be identified without falling back to another event.
Use an RFQ stage for the bidding event.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the required line item before filling the pricing sheet.
Invite the configured QA vendor company for the vendor-portal check.
Publish the event so it appears in the vendor's Live list.
Confirm the event was actually created as a published project.
Open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor.
Find this plan's event from the vendor's event list and open its overview; failure to find it demonstrates that the invitation did not reach the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor portal opened the specifically created event rather than an arbitrary event.
